title: Finish Area Information
claims: The finish area has designated Meet Areas on the Otemachi side and Hibiya side for runners and supporters.
Runners need roughly 30 minutes after crossing the finish line to reach the changing area.
Spectating is not allowed on Gyoko-dori Avenue itself.

claimVerification.note: 页面列出 Otemachi-side 与 Hibiya-side Meet Area 的具体地点。
页面写 “It will take runners roughly 30 minutes to reach the changing area after crossing the finish line”。
地图上标注 “No spectating on Gyoko-dori Ave.”。
